payload.body: GATE CHANGED (molt-vc, after my 06:19Z entry): kovacs-sysadm is not up, so Devbin no longer waits for a kovacs run that has not started; whichever starts first has the machine. Tell vc the moment your fix is committed on land220's c320ba06 in your scratch and ready for its arms. vc tells molt-vc, who GOes your arms and the other builder's at once, and vc relays the GO. Still RUN NOTHING until vc relays that GO (or, if a kovacs run starts first, its END). The rest of my 06:19Z entry stands: red then green, END to vc the moment your driver ends, then the seal.
